title: **__Job Center (City Hall)__**
description:
**Description:**
*A cutting-edge system for managing jobs and businesses. Players browse customizable job tiles with stats like earnings and difficulty, while business owners personalize their company profiles. A multiplayer chat connects job seekers and employers, creating a dynamic and interactive ecosystem.*

fields.name: 🛠️ **Features**
fields.value:
• **Our new system is a comprehensive solution for players that introduces innovative functions for managing work, businesses, and facilitating interactions between users.**
• **The job menu allows players to browse available professions in the form of tiles. Each tile can include:**
• **All statistics are configurable, with the option to hide selected ones.**
• **Players can easily browse available jobs, and clicking on a tile expands a detailed description with information about tasks and requirements.**

fields.name: 🔗 **Dependencies**
fields.value: *The business section allows company owners to present their businesses through the personalization of their tile – including a custom background image and a player-editable description.*

fields.name: ⚙️ **How It Works**
fields.value:
• *We have introduced a special chat for players looking for work in multiplayer mode. Messages are automatically signed with the character's name and surname.*

Ill have no doubts about contacting the support again. Thank you*
